title: Azure soft-deleted Key Vault purged
description: Detects a successful administrative purge of a previously soft-deleted Azure Key Vault.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may purge a soft-deleted Key Vault to prevent recovery of keys and secrets, disrupting systems that depend on them.
hypothesis.rationale: This control-plane event does not disclose the vault's prior contents or whether independent backups exist; approved retirement is possible.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Detects a successful administrative purge of a previously soft-deleted Azure Key Vault.

triage.summary: This control-plane event does not disclose the vault's prior contents or whether independent backups exist; approved retirement is possible.
steps: Review the operation, resource, caller, source address and correlation ID; establish the approved change or recovery owner.
Inspect effective post-change configuration and independent controls, then correlate related role, resource and logging changes.
Validate the business justification and restore the affected control or contain unauthorized access through the consumer's approved process.
false_positives: Approved Key Vault decommissioning or a documented recovery lifecycle operation on a disposable vault.

validation.expected_outcome: Match the bounded event, key/action/path or successful operation combination; reject one-field mutations, lookalikes and absent required fields. Synthetic tests do not establish live telemetry or production performance.

limitations: This control-plane event does not disclose the vault's prior contents or whether independent backups exist; approved retirement is possible.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
